items.title: Pug Horton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 1998
items.q: we would see each other as friends with no thought at all of any escapade, we just loved to talk about jazz.

ctx.x: No. I was 15 years old, and I can remember looking at myself in the mirror and thinking, oh yes, you look kind of cute you know in this thing, and looking at this photograph, that’s what I want. That’s the first time. And I said I’m not being contrary, but when I said I didn’t plan my life, that’s when I said something that I wanted. And I wrote to Bob. I wrote to the Commodore Music Shop and said, “I know you know everybody, could you get me some autographs and photographs?” And Bob apparently said he didn’t get…
Sometimes it is, but not always.
